notes.title: Full Release: Liftoff: Micro Drones
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="_1y8HDyMUhY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
When we launched the Early Access of [b]Liftoff: Micro Drones[/b] back in late 2021, we made a bold promise: to deliver the [b]ultimate simulator for the micro drone class[/b].[/p][p]Today, we’re proud to say, we’ve kept that promise. And it’s all thanks to [b]you[/b]. Your passion, feedback, and unwavering support have shaped every update, every feature, every line of code. [/p][h2]  
TL;DR
[/h2][p]The changelist below is massive—packed with the fixes, features, and fine-tuning you’ve been waiting for. But we know you love a good TL;DR, so here’s what you [i]really[/i] need to know:[/p][list][*][p][b]Track Builder[/b] — The long-awaited, fully custom toolset is finally here. Over a year in the making, built from the ground up to empower your creativity. Create, share and download custom tracks. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/ec655ac2cc5b85286bbeea90f4e51470905c6fb3.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Levels[/b] — Azure District (previously Silverscreen) and Melon Pan Park now feature stunning nighttime versions, each transforming the experience into something entirely new.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/d4dca3158b7d46901e94b165dceb63e504a8b8c8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]UI/UX Polish[/b] — We’ve polished every pixel. Buttons are consistent, menus intuitive, everything feels tighter, smoother, better.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/b895c842a166b188247843522c4591ec60dc9dfc.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]BETAFPV Air75[/b] — You asked. You waited. It's here.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/6bca0acd2481515ec1b93d344a4148430e03ed01.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1432320/achievements"]Steam Achievements[/url] — Track your progress, challenge yourself, and unlock milestones[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/fa407a9b092046e863703438dd78ff98c6487ac5.png"][/img][/p][h1]
Changelist[/h1][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="688"][tr][td colwidth="688"][p][b]New:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Two new environments![/b][/p][list][*][p]Melon Pan Park - Neon City[/p][/*][*][p]Azure District - Grip[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]All new Track Builder[/b][/p][list][*][p]Build and configure your own custom Tracks and Races![/p][/*][*][p]Share your custom content through Steam Workshop[/p][/*][*][p]Place gates, triggers, checkpoints, resizeable blocks, …[/p][/*][*][p]Familiar industry-standard 3D editor controls: 3D gizmo, increment snap, snap points[/p][/*][*][p]Spline placement tools[/p][/*][*][p]Over 175 Track Items with various skins, with more to come![/p][/*][*][p]Empty variants for each “daytime” Environment; and the night variants are under way![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Achievements! You can now switch between purist and regular leaderboards.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated text in the multiplayer game lobby to be more readable.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the default motors for the BetaFPV Air65 frame from 23000kv to 27000kv.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the race guides visualization. Arrows are used for the next checkpoint, and spheres for subsequent ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the race guides’ generation to be more smooth between checkpoints.[/p][/*][*][p]Several new options in the game settings menu:[/p][list][*][p]toggle skip the race countdown[/p][/*][*][p]setting for how many checkpoints ahead the race guides should show[/p][/*][*][p]Threshold for “best lap time” notification[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The next music track starts playing when loading in an environment.[/p][/*][*][p]In the multiplayer game lobby, clicking on a player now shows their leaderboard times and drone setup. You can clone their drone setup to include it in your own fleet.[/p][/*][*][p]The multiplayer chat window now displays new leaderboard high scores set by other players.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the display logic of the multiplayer chat window. placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where rewind would also bring the drone to a previous spawnpoint.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where the flight inputs were being resetting the drone during an ongoing dialog would lock the player out from continuing to fly afterwards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ZetaFlight input issues in the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Hoverdrone collisions would not work as intended when the drone is not armed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where UI becomes unresponsive after a race.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with KISS rates where the yaw channel was always overridden with the pitch channel values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed drone audio getting “stuck” upon disarming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed windshield collider on car in San Lipo Drive.[/p][/*][*][p]Partner logos are no longer low-res in the splash screen on lower quality settings.[/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][h2]

What to Expect Next
[/h2][p]In the days and weeks ahead, we’ve scheduled time for:[/p][list][*][p][b]Rapid fixes and improvements[/b] While we’ve tested extensively, an update of this scale always brings unexpected bugs. We’re ready to respond quickly and keep things running smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Track Builder enhancements [/b]The new Track Builder is a powerful starting point, but we’re not done. Expect additional building elements, quality-of-life improvements, and ongoing polish.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New content in development[/b] The next [b]micro drone[/b] is already in production, and we’re actively conceptualising the [b]next environment[/b], with level production to follow shortly after.[/p][/*][/list][h1]
[/h1][h2]A Heartfelt Thank You
[/h2][p]Once again, we want to express our deepest gratitude to the entire [b]Liftoff[/b] and [b]FPV community[/b] for being part of this journey. FPV has always been a passion-driven niche, and while it may be a smaller market, it’s one with a big heart. Projects like [i]Liftoff: Micro Drones[/i] only exist because of your collective support. Every single pilot makes a difference.[/p][p]What we’re launching today is not just the result of our development efforts, [b]it’s the achievement of an entire community[/b]. True teamwork.[/p][p]A special thank you goes out to our [b]testers[/b], who’ve spent the past weeks relentlessly bug-hunting and stress-testing the new Track Builder. Your dedication and detailed feedback have been invaluable.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/38e99c87a1e905b370ea6810dc01318f27b9eabb.png"][/img][/p][h3]
A Tribute
[/h3][p]Lastly, we’d like to dedicate this launch to someone truly special, [b]a legend in the Liftoff community[/b] whose creativity and passion have touched us all.[/p][p][b]Shane Hirst[/b], known to many as [b]Mekon[/b], gave us countless hours of joy through his incredible tracks. His talent, generosity, and love for the game inspired a generation of pilots and creators.[/p][p]Though he’s no longer with us, his legacy lives on in every turn, dive, and gate we fly.[/p][p][b]This one’s for you, buddy. Thank you, Shane. You will be missed.[/b][/p][p][/p]

[h2]We are on Reddit too! [/h2]

notes.title: Development roadmap update
notes.notes:
It's been a few months since our last update, and we're excited to bring you up to speed on all the exciting new developments!

First of all, we're thrilled to announce that our team has moved into a brand new studio! After eight years in our previous rental space, we spent two months working from home while our new studio was being set up. Now, we're fully up and running in our very own studio space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/34365a55632d20cb844bdce41ecda45144507d77.png[/img]

We have already enjoyed racing our micro drones trough the new studio. Would you like us to turn this into an actual Liftoff: Micro Drones level? Let us know!  

[h2]V1 plans[/h2]

During that time we have set up a plan of action for the next milestone: our official V1 release where we transition the Liftoff: Micro Drones from an Early Access project to a full release. We have two mayor goals in mind for this V1 launch update:

A track builder, not just a port of the old track builder from classic Liftoff, but a brand new toolset build from scratch, focusing on the feedback and suggestions collected over the years. In our first team meeting at the new studio, we finalized the plans, and development is already progressing well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/2ccae184a0a617fe0ce86d7f1c2d50c8a03b744f.jpg[/img]

Here are some features you can expect from our new track builder, which will also be included in classic Liftoff:
[list][*] Completely redesigned user experience, featuring improved tools and drag-and-drop functionality
[*] Freeform navigation
[*] Multi-object selection and manipulation
[*] Item duplication
[*] Additional grid-based placement options
[/list]

Additionally, we are excited to share that the launch of V1 will include the highly anticipated Melon Pan Park level. We're thrilled to give you an exclusive first look beyond the initial teasers we shared. This new level is designed to be the ultimate compilation of all the requests we've received: an outdoor playground set in an urban city environment. It will be our most intricate and detailed Liftoff: Micro Drones level to date, offering abundant opportunities for both freestyle and racing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/5fc9a16c474621b8088f4a49dd3122fe478096bf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/c8c879a9ca3f63a68df09de9382663318b8d12f0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/58ad3fcf05ade52e167ae75b7e529da8ab38315c.png[/img]

The big question on everyone's mind is: "When will we get this?" We'll continue working until everything feels just right, so we don't have an exact launch date yet. While we are aiming for a release in late summer, it's possible that it may be pushed to sometime after.

[h2]Thats not all[/h2]

Of course, that's not all we have in the works. We're continually developing a variety of new features and content, including the brand-new Hisingy drone, which will be added in an update before the V1 release. Additionally, we're excited about post-launch updates. While not set in stone, we're exploring ideas such as new game modes, competitive features, achievements, daily missions, etc.

[h2]Battery simulation[/h2]
We have enhanced the battery simulation for increased realism. Previously, the amp draw was too low, resulting in batteries behaving like timers. Now, your choice of battery significantly influences the simulation. Low-capacity or low C-rating batteries may prematurely die or overheat. Battery sag has been refined for greater responsiveness, exhibiting a slight voltage drop when the load increases, recovering swiftly, and a slower, more enduring drop when pushed excessively.

We are excited to get your feedback on this new battery simulation!

notes.title: Experimental Branch - Physics update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/d4111ef788e42673270db5c79014595f90f79828.png[/img]

These past few months the team at LuGus Studios has carefully gone over every single line of code of the physics and flight behaviour systems in Liftoff: Micro Drones. While at its core Liftoff: Micro Drones uses the same simulation technology found in other Liftoff simulators, many systems have been redesigned with the micro drone class in mind.  A few small errors in the system have been fixed and some parameters have been tweaked. We are now ready for testing them on a temporary Experimental Branch. 

[h2]What and why?[/h2]
While Liftoff: Micro Drones is still in Early Access, we want each public version to offer an enjoyable and stable experience. This puts a lot of pressure on our development team whenever we are pushing for crucial updates that can have a big impact on the game. The Experimental Branch allows us to release experimental features (such as physics updates) much faster for testing, without having to worry too much about polish yet. It also allows us to break the game to a certain extent if needed, and try out features that we are not sure should make it to the final game yet. For the development team it means we have more freedom, for the player it means they can have an even bigger impact on the development and progress of the game. 

By testing the Liftoff Experimental Branch and giving us feedback, you help us, and weigh in on the decisions we make for the future of Liftoff: Micro Drones.    

[h2]Experimental Branch: what you need to know[/h2]
[list][*] The Experimental Branch (EB) should be used for testing purposes only.  
[*] At any time you can switch back to the main version of the game. We recommend doing this after testing.  
[*] Versions on the game on the EB can be expected to be unpolished, buggy and unbalanced.  
[*] It is to be expected that not all game features work on the EB.  
[*] Features and updates available on the EB are not guaranteed to make it to the main branch of the game.  
[*] The dev team cannot give dedicated support for experimental game versions available on the EB.  
[/list]

[h2]How to get access to the Experimental Branch[/h2][olist]
[*]Right click on “Liftoff: Micro Drones” in your Steam Library  
[*]Click “Properties”  
[*]In the “Properties” menu, click the “BETAS” tab  
[*]Select “Experimental Branch” in the dropdown menu
[*]Restart Steam to trigger the download. Happy testing!
[/olist]

In order to switch back to the normal version of Liftoff: Micro Drones, follow the same instructions, but instead of selecting “Experimental Branch” in the last step, select “NONE - Opt out of all beta programs”.

[h2]What feedback do we need?[/h2]
Very simple, our primary question is: does this feel better? Yes/No?

Answering that question will allow us to learn if our fixes and tweaks have worked. If the answer is a clear YES, we can push these improvements to the public version of the game. Any additional feedback is more than welcome! We'd love to know in more detail how you feel about the flight behaviour, where exactly you think things feel strange, at what scale things feel different etc. 

If you encounter any bugs, weird behaviour, or if you have more general remarks about Liftoff Experimental Branch, please contact us through:    

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1432320/discussions/]The dedicated Steam Forum  [/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/AhUZmRmX]The official Liftoff Discord server [/url] 
[url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/Liftoffcommunity]The Liftoff Community Group on Facebook   [/url] 

Thank you very much for your help, and happy testing!

Liftoff: Micro Drones update 0.5.2 is here and builds upon the foundations laid by the Milestone update. Today we expand the singleplayer racing experience, by introducing race bots and race guides. Enjoy!

[h2]Changelist[/h2]
[list][*]Added: bots for all race tracks. These can be found in the  Race, Infinite Race and Hoverdrone Race game modes.

[h2]Bots: learning from the best[/h2]
You'll never feel alone in Liftoff: Micro Drones, the simulator now features bots in singleplayer race modes. The secret to our bots is that they are completely player-driven. They learn to fly using real player data and adapt to your flying skills, to offer you an interesting challenge each time. Do you feel the bots are too easy or too hard to beat, just finish a few races and they'll quickly learn and adapt.

[h2]Be social[/h2]
Please say hello on our community channels, we are excited to meet you!
The Liftoff dev team is very active on the multiple Liftoff community channels, always happy to answer your questions, share some development insights and tease what's next. 

Make sure to join the community on [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/Liftoffcommunity]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/uZQMXZUN]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Update 0.4.3 released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/b73e8e5a0c191bbd0b65ca1d736e2808f40d4899.jpg[/img]
We are ending the year in style with a final Liftoff: Micro Drones update for 2021. Thank you for your support and enthusiasm, it makes a massive difference!  Stay tuned for an amazing 2022! 
 
[h2]Changelist[/h2]
[list][*] Tweaked drag values, this should result in a more locked in feeling. 
[*] Introduced damage calculation differences for frames with and without prop guards.
[*] Update the damage indicator with colors, should be easier to notice prop damage. 
[*] Level selector has been added to the singleplayer finish screen, quickly jump to the next level or track when finishing a race. 
[*] Some ground surfaces should now slide more.
[*] More drone customisation options: added a motor category 
[*] Added 3 brushed and 10 brushless motor variations. These impact flight behaviour. 
[/list]

[h2]Flight behaviour tweaks[/h2]
Last week’s throttle update was a success: you tried it out, liked it (awesome!) and provided us with additional feedback. This feedback all pointed in the same direction, tweaking the drag value might push it another step closer to perfection. In this update, the drag coefficient has been slightly increased, this should make the micro drones feel more locked in: sharper cornering, less drifting, and a slight decrease in overall speed. Your favourite Micro Drone should now be a lot more controllable, without losing that magic fun feeling we already offered in previous versions. We’d love to know what you think! 

[h2]More content and customisation[/h2]
The current Early Access version already offers solid fun experience, but can’t hold its ground in terms of content compared to classic sims like Liftoff, that have had a 6 year head start. Introducing new content to Liftoff: Micro Drones is a long-term endeavour that starts with this update. 
Included are more parts to customise your setup, now you can change the motors of your favourite Micro Drones, impacting not just the way your drone looks but also flies. 

Early next year we hope to introduce a few additional frames, and soon after we’ll be teasing the next level that's currently in production.

notes.title: Update 0.4.2 released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/4035c8f34a1d193a470be1a55e97685c2e8287a6.png[/img]
This update introduces 2 changes that have been at the center of the feedback we have received from you. 

We noticed pilots new to Liftoff simulators were unaware of some of our shortcuts (example: "V" to change camera "A" to change flight mode). It was clear we needed to make information of these shortcuts more easily available. Before, you could only access our Button menu by going to Options in the Main Menu. We have reworked the systems to be more easily offered at different locations in the game: more specifically you can now access the Button setup menu in the Pause menu, while playing the game. 

Another point of feedback was the flight behaviour. Different pilots look for different things, have different experiences, opinions and preferences. Collecting feedback as early as possible is key to making a successful simulator, that's what Early Access is all about. Our goal is to work incrementally and keep tweaking and improving physics and flight behaviour for years to come, as there's no such thing as a perfect simulation. This update introduces some first tweaks to throttle controls and should also make the drones feel slightly more powerful. Your feedback on these changes should help us define the next step in flight behaviour improvements.  
 Disclaimer: some of your fleet setups (and Workshop uploads) might need to be tweaked again. 

[h2]Changelist:[/h2]
[list][*]Reworking our Button setup menu to be consistent at different places in the game. 
[*]Making the Button setup menu available in the Pause menu, easy to access during gameplay.
[*]Providing a first tweak to the flight behaviour: drones might feel slightly more powerful and will require less throttle input to start hovering. 
[*]Decreased project size by 2Gb.
[/list]

[h2]Thank you! [/h2]
Liftoff: Micro Drones is a love letter to the FPV community and we have gotten nothing but love back. Our launch was super exciting and we are glad you joined us to explore and improve this new adventure we have started. It’s been so great to finally fly together in our virtual micro drone environments! Thank you so much!  

The wealth of responses is heartwarming, and the dedication from the community to provide us with valuable feedback and suggestions is all we could have wished for.  Liftoff: Micro Drones is very much a project in the middle of development. It's [url=https://www.liftoff-game.com/support?topic=153&category=8&post=168]currently incomplete[/url] and contains a fair amount of bugs. To everyone who dedicated time to write us a post, email or chat in-game: thank you, we are listening!  The past few days we have redefined our priority lists for the next few days and weeks. notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40507255/72b668092c930e0506f4962453c32a4b4a3af1ae.png[/img]

[url=https://www.liftoff-game.com/our-products/liftoff-micro-drones]Liftoff: Micro Drones[/url], the latest game in a series of the popular Liftoff drone simulators, will be available in Early Access starting from [b]November 30th[/b]. The Early Access version will be exclusively available on Steam for PC, Mac and Linux.

Liftoff: Micro Drones is an authentic standalone drone simulator, dedicated to the magic of the smallest class of drones. The simulator will use the latest Liftoff physics developments, modern graphics, a slick and up-to-date user experience, six unique micro drones, drone customisation, three realistic environments in two variations each ([url=https://www.liftoff-game.com/news/environment-design-philosophy]providing 6 different experiences[/url]), different game modes such as Race, Hoverdrone Race, Freeflight and Party Popper. The Early Access version will feature single player and multiplayer experience.

Additional drones, parts, environments, game modes and features are expected to be added as free updates later on. Additionally, features expected for the future full release are a dedicated tutorial, more game modes, a track builder and a progression system.

The [url=https://www.liftoff-game.com/support?topic=153&category=8&post=168]Early Access[/url] version of Liftoff: Micro Drones will cost [b]€14,99[/b]. This one-time purchase price covers all future updates. Supporters get instant access to this early version of the game. The release version of Liftoff: Micro Drones is expected to cost €19,99 at launch.


[b]Disclaimer:[/b]
The Early Access version is not a finished product. Early access is recommended only for those who are willing to support an in-development project and want to get an early look at the game. The Early Access phase will be used to gather feedback and suggestions and will help us shape the final release version of the game.
